## The Lunarians

The Lunarians once lived atop the Red Line and were called gods. King may be the last of them.

Be of the Lunarian race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Lunarian race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## Flames of the Red Line

When a Lunarian's flame burns, almost nothing gets through their skin.

Unlock one Lunarian flame technique: Flame Blast, Flaming Blow or Flame Shroud.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Lunarians](r_lunarian.md#q-6e99af2567c6940f)

**Tasks**

- Unlock 1 of: Flame Blast, Flaming Blow, Flame Shroud

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

## King's Endurance

The World Government tried to break King in every way it knew, until Kaido broke him out of its laboratory on Punk Hazard.

Enter the Nether and unlock two Lunarian flame techniques.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Lost Homeland](r_lunarian.md#q-3b303d594003181d)

**Tasks**

- Enter the Nether
- Unlock 2 of: Flame Blast, Flaming Blow, Flame Shroud

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)

## The Last Lunarian

Vegapunk studied King's lineage to build the Seraphim. Egghead holds what he learned.

Land on a ruins island in the New World and reach 42,500 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [King's Endurance](r_lunarian.md#q-24ef09bb7705740f)

**Tasks**

- Land on a ruins island in the New World
- Reach 42,500 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +100,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your race)
